message:
The other night, we had a little power outage. At first, I was scrambling to find the flashlights and power banks, but then I noticed how cozy it felt with all the lights out. I grabbed a couple of lanterns and set them up around the living room. 

We made it a fun evening, playing card games by lantern light and enjoying some snacks from the fridge before they got too warm. It reminded me that sometimes, a little unexpected situation can turn into a lovely memory. 

Have you ever made the best of a blackout? I'd love to hear your tips for cozying up during power outages!
